en-US: Let note owners turn on an optional auto-generated password when sharing a public link. Visitors must unlock the page before reading the note or attachments; existing public links stay open until a password is enabled.
Probe model CORS with a dummy POST so browser direct-connect sends Authorization instead of falling back to the instance proxy on hosts that reject GET or HEAD preflights.
Accept instance hosts without an https prefix, and ignore leftover desktop instance URLs in the browser so web sessions do not call a saved desktop API.
Keep the login card shadow from becoming a light halo in dark mode.
Rename the generate assistant tab from Instruction to Q&A.
Remove Beta badges from mind-map, flowchart, and architecture note types in the create-memo menu.
zh-CN: 分享公开链接时可开启自动生成的访问密码。访客需先解锁才能阅读笔记和附件；已有公开链接在开启密码前保持可直接访问。
用空 POST 探测模型 CORS，让网页直连带上 Authorization，不再因主机拒绝 GET/HEAD 预检而回退到实例代理。
登录时可填写不带 https 前缀的实例地址；浏览器会忽略桌面端留下的实例 URL，避免网页会话误连到桌面保存的接口。
修复深色模式下登录卡片阴影变成浅色光环的问题。
将生成助手标签从「指令」改为「问答模式」。
去掉侧栏新建菜单里思维导图、流程图和架构图旁的 Beta 标记。
